title: Notsapain'ny Renirano ny Fanjakana
intro: Nisy mpitarika nitsangana araka ny didin'Andriamanitra tamin'ny andro fahiny. Nanomboka tsy tamim-boninahitra ny fanjakan'ity mpitondra ity fa tamin'ny fitsapana tamin'ny rano mikoriana. Hisy fahavalo goavana iray hifanandrina amin'ny tafiny, ary ny vokany dia hanova ny fizotran'ny tantara. Azonao an-tsaina ve hoe iza io olona io?
clues: Voafidy hitarika firenena lehibe aho, saingy avy any ambony ny fanendrena, fa tsy avy amin'ny vahoaka.
Naverina tamin'ny oloko ny zavatra masina iray ho famantarana ny fitondrany.
Notsapaiko tamin'ny renirano ny miaramilako — ny ankamaroany dia nisotro tamin'izany fa tsy nahomby.
Nisy mpiady mahery iray antsoina hoe Jalut tonga nanafika anay niaraka tamin'ny tafika lehibe.
Nisy tovolahy iray avy amiko, izay tsy nanana afa-tsy finoana nirongo fiadiana, namely an'i Jalut.
Taorian'ny fandresentsika, dia natolotra an'io tompondaka tanora io ihany ny fanjakana.

location.label: Singa fototra

outcome.label: vokatra
options: Nafindra tany amin'ilay tompondaka tanora (Dawud) ny fanjakana
Nilentika niaraka tamin'ny tafika tao an-dranomasina
Voasintona soa aman-tsara avy tao anaty afo mirehitra
Nodorana velona tao anaty tatatra mirehitra
outcome.answer: Nafindra tany amin'ilay tompondaka tanora (Dawud) ny fanjakana

arabic: فَلَمَّا فَصَلَ طَالُوتُ بِٱلْجُنُودِ قَالَ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ مُبْتَلِيكُم بِنَهَرٍۢ فَمَن شَرِبَ مِنْهُ فَلَيْسَ مِنِّى وَمَن لَّمْ يَطْعَمْهُ فَإِنَّهُۥ مِنِّىٓ إِلَّا مَنِ ٱغْتَرَفَ غُرْفَةًۢ بِيَدِهِۦ ۚ فَشَرِبُوا۟ مِنْهُ إِلَّا قَلِيلًۭا مِّنْهُمْ ۚ فَلَمَّا جَاوَزَهُۥ هُوَ وَٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ مَعَهُۥ قَالُوا۟ لَا طَاقَةَ لَنَا ٱلْيَوْمَ بِجَالُوتَ وَجُنُودِهِۦ ۚ قَالَ ٱلَّذِينَ يَظُنُّونَ أَنَّهُم مُّلَـٰقُوا۟ ٱللَّهِ كَم مِّن فِئَةٍۢ قَلِيلَةٍ غَلَبَتْ فِئَةًۭ كَثِيرَةًۢ بِإِذْنِ ٱللَّهِ ۗ وَٱللَّهُ مَعَ ٱلصَّـٰبِرِينَ
verse: And when Saul went forth with the soldiers, he said, "Indeed, Allāh will be testing you with a river. So whoever drinks from it is not of me, and whoever does not taste it is indeed of me, excepting one who takes [from it] in the hollow of his hand." But they drank from it, except a [very] few of them. Then when he had crossed it along with those who believed with him, they said, "There is no power for us today against Goliath and his soldiers." But those who were certain that they would meet Allāh said, "How many a small company has overcome a large company by permission of Allāh. And Allāh is with the patient." (2:249)
